title: Ghost PowerToys Run window when using Win+, while PowerToys Run is open
author: ReginaldTang
summary: PowerToys Run leaves a visible ghost surface after Win+Comma while open; the report has concise steps and a recording.

status.label: Design investigation queued
status.detail: The issue has concise steps and a recording; no maintainer action is defensible until the Run hide/deactivation path is reproduced and designed.

next_action.label: Continue Run ghost-window design
next_action.reason: Investigate Win+Comma desktop-peek deactivation, hide animation, and stale visual state without requesting duplicate generic diagnostics first.

judgment.rationale: The two-step reproduction and recording are sufficient to investigate PowerToys Run deactivation/hide behavior; no comments or linked work changed that routing.
evidence: Steps are: open PowerToys Run, then press Win+Comma.
The reporter compares expected behavior to Command Palette closing and says Win+D does not apply.
The issue includes a video attachment showing the ghost window.
PowerLauncher MainWindow handles Deactivated and calls MainViewModel.Hide when HideWhenDeactivated is enabled.
judgment.recommended_action: Continue a focused design investigation of Win+Comma shell deactivation, hide/animation completion, compositor state, and Run visibility transitions.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run leaves a visible ghost surface after Win+Comma while open; the report has concise steps and a recording.
known_information: The report was captured on PowerToys 0.100.2 from the Microsoft Store.
The reproduction is two steps: open PowerToys Run and press Win+Comma.
The reporter says Win+D does not produce the same comparison behavior and Command Palette closes as expected.
A video attachment demonstrates the ghost surface.
There are no comments, assignees, cross-references, or closing PRs on the issue.
inferences: The Win+Comma desktop-peek transition may exercise a deactivation/composition path that differs from Win+D.
The ghost may be stale visual/compositor state or an incomplete hide animation rather than an active Run window.
issue_context.analysis: The behavior is specific enough for design reproduction and source tracing. A request-info action would ask for broad diagnostics even though the issue already supplies the trigger and visual evidence.
initial_investigation: Forced 2026-09-02 pass read the complete issue body, labels, empty assignee list, and timeline links; there are no issue comments or linked work.
Read src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/MainWindow.xaml.cs: OnDeactivated calls _viewModel.Hide when HideWhenDeactivated is enabled.
Read src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/ViewModel/MainViewModel.cs: Hide toggles Wox when the main window is not collapsed, and PowerToysRunSettings defaults HideWhenDeactivated to true.
